full_judgment:
FRM Nazmul Ahasan J: This appeal was filed by the defendant appellants against the Judgment and decree dated 20-6-1999 and 28-6-1999 respectively passed by the learned Sub-ordinate Judge, 3rd Court, Chittagong, in Money Suit No. 33 of 1995 decreeing the suit. 

 5. The trial Court after considering the plaint, written statement, depositions of PW 1, and other materials on record decreed the suit. 

 6. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with impugned Judgment and decree of the trial Court the defendants as appellants preferred the instant appeal. 

 7. Mr Md Ohiullah, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the appellants submits that there is no difference between Bill of Lading figures and the found as per ullage survey report prior to commencing this discharge of the cargo to the shore tanks. He further submits that as per ullage survey 1999.632 metric tons of Toilet Soap Grade Tallow were discharged from one consignment and from another consignment 1999.779 metric tons were discharged to the shore tanks and as such learned trial Court wrongly found short-age of the cargo on the basis of the report of shore tank survey which was done after disconnecting the hose pipes from the vessel. He further submits that the trial Court erred in law in finding that 23.592 metric tons of tallow was detected short as per joint survey report after discharging of cargo from the tanker to the defendants. The trial Court ought to have considered that the defendants are not liable for the alleged shortage of cargo. Furthermore, the carrier is also entitled to 1% Ocean allowance as inevitable loss while carrying in bulk oil trade. Therefore, the decree passed by the trial Court cannot be maintained. 

 11. Therefore, we hold that the assessment of the compensation in the present case was not made in accordance with law. The Court below passed the judgment and decree erroneously and, as such, it is liable to be set aside. 

 12. Accordingly, the appeal is allowed without any order as to costs. Impugned judgment and decree dated 20-6-1999 and 28-6-1999 respectively passed by the Subordinate Judge, 3rd Court, Chittagong, in Money Suit No. 33 of 1995 is hereby set aside. The suit is dismissed.
